push.body:
A 7.7, BellyTb1. That's a speed bump, not a wall.

THE GOOD
+ 32 passes (up from your usual 17). Everybody wanted the ball at your feet, and for good reason.
+ A goal against man united2112, your first since Oct 1. Every team needs someone who smells goals. You've got the nose.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after buddskees walked off. That's what showing up looks like.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Next match: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
- 72% passing (23 of 32). Coach's tip: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- No key passes from 32 passes. Game plan: Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from. Simple as Sunday.
- Shot accuracy 67%, down from your usual 93%. Write this down: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 3. Ain't no hiding from that one. Good. Now we learn from it.

Fundamentals drill: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

BellyTb1, something I want you to sleep on: Be a goldfish about mistakes and an elephant about lessons.

We're building something here. - Coach Lasso
